verdict.rationale: Unreal documents integrated source control through Perforce and SVN. The integration gives a history of changes and lets any file be rolled back to an earlier version, which covers automation assets such as Blueprints, Python scripts and C++ code stored in the project. However, it relies on an external VCS and is a general asset/code feature, not something built specifically for automations. Missing for 10: any documented review/diff workflow for automation changes, automation-specific versioning (e.g. versioned Remote Control presets or scripts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
